title: 第 90章 侠义金第89 章 故地重游
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 石滩镇不算大，一条主街从东贯到西。
街面上铺着青石板，年头久了，被车轮和马蹄磨得油光水滑。
镇子依着一道浅河，河对岸便是层层叠叠的青山，瞧着倒有几分世外桃源的意思。
可这份清净，近来被搅了个干净。
沈回是傍晚时分到的。
远远便望见镇子入口处设了一道栅栏，几个挎刀的汉子懒洋洋地靠在栅栏旁，见有人来，便伸手一拦。
“进镇先交侠义金。”
领头的是个精瘦汉子，腮上长着一颗大黑痣，乍一看好似贴着一块膏药。
“侠义金？”沈回有些疑惑。
“就是过路费，一人十个铜板。”
另一人坐在栅栏后的条凳上开口。
他面前摆着一张方桌，桌上搁着一壶茶和一只豁了口的陶碗，正拿草帽扇风。
沈回倒也没有多说什么，只是问了一句：“贵镇叫什么名字？”
“石滩县。”
那汉子把茶碗里的残茶往地上一泼，又续了些新的，随口道：
“不过这‘县’字如今也不大用得上了。县太爷月前就死了，衙门也空了，如今这里归我们陈大侠管。”
他说这话时，语气里颇有几分得意。
沈回见他这般神色，便顺着问了句：
“陈大侠？”
那汉子一听，顿时来了精神，把茶碗往桌上一搁，身子往前探了探：
“外乡来的，不知道也不奇怪。我跟你说，我们陈大侠那是真正的英雄好汉，专替穷人出头。谁家被恶霸欺辱了，他便去讨个公道。”
“讨公道？”沈回挑了挑眉。
那汉子伸出大拇指，在脖子上一划：
“恶霸强抢民女，便杀了恶霸。豪强霸占田地，便杀了豪强。衙门里头那个贪官，贪了多少年的银子，陈大侠二话不说，一剑便把他脑袋削了下来。你说，这是不是替天行道？”
沈回没有接话，只是微微侧了侧头。
他的目光越过栅栏，望向镇子里面。
镇子的街道倒也干净，两旁的铺子都开着门，看起来倒是比寻常的偏远小镇要热闹几分。
他收回目光，什么也没说，从怀中掏出十枚铜板，搁在桌上。
那汉子低头数了数，又抬头看了看陆欢，下巴一扬：“她也要交。”

;;
Shitan Town is not that big, with one main street running from east to west.
The streets are paved with bluestone slabs, which have been worn over time by wheels and horses' hooves to make them slippery.
The town is located along a shallow river, and on the other side of the river are layers of green mountains, which makes it look like a paradise.
But this purity has been disturbed recently.
Shen Hui arrived in the evening.
From a distance, I saw a fence set up at the entrance of the town. Several men carrying knives lazily leaned against the fence. When they saw someone coming, they stretched out their hands to stop them.
"Pay chivalry gold before entering the town."
The leader was a lean man with a large black mole on his cheek, which at first glance looked like a plaster.
"Chivalry gold?" Shen Hui was a little confused.
"It's just the toll, ten coppers per person."
Another man sat on a bench behind the fence and spoke.
There was a square table in front of him, with a pot of tea and a cracked pottery bowl on the table, and he was fanning himself with a straw hat.
Shen Hui didn't say much, he just asked: "What's the name of your town?"
"Shitan County."
The man poured the remaining tea in the tea bowl onto the ground, added some new tea, and said casually:
"But the word 'county' is not very useful nowadays. The county grandpa died a month ago, and the government office is empty. Now this place is under the control of our hero Chen."
When he said this, his tone was quite proud.
Seeing his expression, Shen Hui asked:
"Master Chen?"
When the man heard this, he immediately became energetic. He put the tea bowl on the table and leaned forward:
"It's strange to be from a foreign country and don't know. Let me tell you, our Daxia Chen is a real hero who specializes in standing up for the poor. If someone is bullied by a bully, he will go and seek justice."
"Seeking justice?" Shen Hui raised his eyebrows.
"Kill."
The man stretched out his thumb and scratched his neck:
"The bully killed the bully when he robbed the daughter of the people. The powerful man took over the land and killed the powerful man. That corrupt official in the government office had been embezzling money for many years. Without saying a word, Master Chen cut off his head with a sword. Do you think this is justice for heaven?"
Shen Hui did not answer, but tilted his head slightly.
He looked over the fence into the town.
The streets in the town are quite clean, and the shops on both sides are open. It seems to be a bit more lively than an ordinary remote town.
He looked away, said nothing, took out ten coins from his arms and put them on the table.
The man lowered his head and counted, then looked up at Lu Huan and raised his chin: "She wants to pay too."
